text: Ash and his girlfriend Linda take a getaway to [a cabin deep in the woods|trigger|travelling somewhere remote], where Ash plays an archaeologist's tape [reciting from the Book of the Dead|origin|deliberately called up]. An unseen force sweeps in, Linda becomes a deadite, the bridge out is gone, and Ash's bitten hand [turns against him|threat|being taken over] until he takes a chainsaw to it. The archaeologist's daughter Annie arrives with the missing pages, and as the trees and the dead in the cellar wake, the book offers [a ritual to banish the evil|ending|the evil is cast out].
